source_title: GHMC Citizen Charter & Service Delivery Guidelines
content: Potholes and road surface damage on municipal roads fall under the GHMC Engineering Wing (Roads). Standard repair SLA is 48 hours for arterial and sub-arterial roads. High severity applies to potholes exceeding 10cm depth or situated in high-speed traffic corridors.

source_title: GHMC Solid Waste Management Operational Framework
content: Overflowing dumper bins, illegal solid waste dumping on roadsides, and road sweeping fall under the GHMC Health & Sanitation Wing. Standard clearance SLA is 24 hours. Waste piles blocking pedestrian walkways or adjacent to water bodies receive elevated priority.

source_publisher: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board
content: Sewerage overflows, missing or damaged manhole lids, and drinking water pipeline bursts fall exclusively under HMWSSB. Standard response SLA is 24 hours. Open/damaged manholes on roadways represent immediate life-safety hazards and are treated as emergency priority.

source_publisher: Telangana State Southern Power Distribution Company Ltd
content: Low-hanging live electrical conductors, tilted distribution poles, sparking distribution transformers, and exposed fuse boxes fall under TGSPDCL Operation Circle. Standard response SLA is 12 hours. Any sagging wire within pedestrian reach is an emergency life hazard.

source_title: HYDRAA Disaster Response & Waterbody Protection Charter
content: Severe urban waterlogging, primary storm water drain (NALA) blockages, and lake buffer zone encroachments are handled by the HYDRAA Disaster Response Team in coordination with GHMC DRF. Response SLA for flash waterlogging is under 6 hours.

source_title: Hyderabad Traffic Police Civic Traffic Redressal
content: Malfunctioning traffic signals, timer failures, and major traffic-obstructing physical obstacles fall under the Traffic Police Engineering Wing. Emergency SLA for signal malfunction at high-density junctions is 4 to 12 hours.
